name: How long does it take to install a new energy-efficient sliding door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new energy-efficient sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a new energy-efficient sliding door typically ranges from a half-day to a full day for a standard replacement. This includes removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing the new unit, ensuring proper sealing and insulation, and cleaning up. More complex installations, such as those requiring structural modifications or custom framing, may extend the timeline. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption to your home during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard installation usually takes a half to a full day, including removal, new door placement, sealing, and cleanup. Complex projects may take longer.
